title: Choose the docs site's structure
question: The look stays Prava's own Cobalt Porcelain. These are three different page structures for the docs site. Lock one, steer it, or re-roll. The catalog's outside worlds (an acetate-tab manual, a plate annual, build instructions) were weighed and declined, because each would bring its own visual identity, and you chose Prava's.

options.label: Search-first index
options.lineage: a reference book's index and thumb tabs
options.thesis: Any component in two keystrokes: the home page is a searchable A to Z index, and each component page is split into Examples, Props and Accessibility tabs under a sticky title bar.
options.viewport: A top bar with Get started, Components and Guides, plus a search field. Below it, a short pitch and the install command, then every component in grouped columns with its one-line purpose.
options.risk: Props sit behind a tab, so evaluators who only skim may not see how complete the API is.

options.label: Field-guide pages
options.lineage: naturalist field guides: identify, then detail
options.thesis: Each component page answers in a fixed order: when to use it, a live example with inline dark and RTL toggles, its anatomy with slot classes labeled, props, then keyboard behavior.
options.viewport: Left nav grouped by category, a reading column opening with the component name and a 'Use it for / Not for' pair, the live example in a porcelain tray, and an 'On this page' list on the right.
options.risk: Long pages, and every component needs its usage guidance and anatomy written.

options.label: Live specimen home
options.thesis: The home page is a real, working settings screen built entirely from Prava components. Hovering any part names it and links to its page, so the library proves itself before a word of pitch.
options.viewport: A one-line pitch with install and Get started on the left. The live settings specimen fills the right two-thirds, with a light, dark and RTL switcher on its frame.
options.risk: The specimen has to be kept working as components change, and the home page is heavier to load.
